context:
Make the product-tier decision first. If MCP is intentionally narrower, make
that explicit and test docs. If parity is required, create a shared service
below CLI and MCP rather than binding MCP to CLI command code.
description:
MCP is intentionally not routed through CLI internals today. A completed
project decision moved MCP onto the public BaseBenchmark.run_with_platform
API, while MCP's exposed parameters remain narrower than CLI and docs appear
behind actual tool options. The architecture question is product scope, not a
simple "call the CLI orchestrator" fix.

This item decides whether MCP is a smoke/control-plane surface or a
CLI-equivalent execution surface. If it becomes CLI-equivalent, introduce a
shared core execution service below both CLI and MCP rather than coupling MCP
to CLI internals.

anti_patterns.dont: add MCP params without schema-derived or tested docs
anti_patterns.why: docs drift is the known failure mode.

anti_patterns.dont: call MCP smoke-only in conversation while docs imply general benchmark execution
anti_patterns.why: choose one tier and document it.

anti_patterns.dont: route MCP through BenchmarkOrchestrator just because it has more flags
anti_patterns.instead: create a non-CLI service if parity is required.

deferrals.reason: Only valid if the explicit fidelity decision chooses CLI-equivalent.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] conditional-unmet: Decision recorded: MCP is a smoke/control-plane surface, not CLI-equivalent; exposing every CLI flag was explicitly not selected.
deferrals.summary: Expose every CLI flag through MCP

preserves.behavior: Do not broaden MCP parameters without updating docs and tests in the same change.
Do not import CLI command modules from benchbox.mcp.
Do not undo the completed decision to use public run_with_platform unless an ADR explicitly supersedes it.

work_units.notes:
Decision recorded in docs/reference/public-contracts.md and
docs/reference/mcp.md: MCP is a beta-public smoke/control-plane automation
surface, not a CLI-equivalent execution surface.

The supported run options are platform, benchmark, scale_factor, queries,
phases, mode, capture_plans, dry_run, and validate_only. CLI-only controls
are documented as product-scope omissions, not hidden parameters or current
implementation debt. Dry-run preview is documented as the core default
load/power model rather than phase-param parity. MCP result bundles are
schema-comparable to CLI-generated result bundles, but MCP does not claim
CLI option parity.
work_units.summary: Decision gate: classify MCP as smoke/control-plane or CLI-equivalent

work_units.notes:
Implemented the smoke/control-plane path. No shared run service was added
because CLI equivalence was explicitly not selected for this product tier.
The implementation change is docs and contract-test alignment; no
benchbox.mcp dependency on benchbox.cli was introduced.
work_units.summary: Implement the selected MCP fidelity path without CLI-internal coupling
